title: Compact-support projection comparison equations
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a family of categories B(X) on finite-type D.k-schemes, a push stage S, tensor bifunctors T, specified exchange data A and second-input predicates P, as in [def-sf-operation-stages] and [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates]. Define CompactSupportProjectionCoherence S T A P to be the conjunction of the compactification-change, composition, associativity-pentagon and proper-counit equations of CompactSupportProjectionLaws S T A P, with exactly their original maps, hypotheses and domains. This predicate includes neither invertibility nor naturality.

mathlib_searches.results: CategoryTheory.Localization.Monoidal.functorMonoidalOfComp_μ_assoc; Localization.Monoidal.pentagon and its auxiliary lemmas; general localization composition laws.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Monoidal associator coherence is available, but not these compact-support compositor and proper-counit equations.

mathlib_searches.results: msearch grep: zero hits. Local search found CompactSupportProjectionLaws only in ConstructibleProjectionMates, the three stage-law modules, their assembly and consumers. ProjectionFormulaCoherence assumes SixFunctorDatum and imports CompactSupportProjectionFormula; it would be circular here.
mathlib_searches.verdict: No existing predicate separating the four equations and no usable theorem transporting them for an operation datum.
